answer_1.quote: We propose a novel Intention Reasoning Network (IR-Net), which is a memory-augmented Seq2Seq model ... to generate more accurate responses. ... We conduct experiments on two publicly available multi-domain datasets, namely SMD and Multi-WOZ 2.1.

answer_2.quote: We follow several previous work, we use BLEU and F1 (including both macro-F1 and micro-F1) to evaluate our model versus existing models. Moreover, to evaluate the performance in a more fine-grained level, we also choose Rouge-1 and Rouge-2 as metrics.

answer_4.quote: The human evaluation mainly focuses on six aspects: helpfulness, appropriateness, correctness, fluency, friendliness, and human-likeness... We hired human experts to score the responses and golden responses on a scale from 1 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators rate each generated response on a 1‑5 scale for each of the six criteria (helpfulness, appropriateness, correctness, fluency, friendliness, human-likeness).
